Create an integrated high-speed handling regression for the 2025 BMW M5 that reproduces the user's keyboard-corner complaint on the rebuilt Showcase Circuit or an equivalent deterministic road maneuver. Measure actual center steer angle, front slip angle, front lateral force/grip utilization, yaw rate, lateral acceleration, and trajectory response at representative speeds (roughly 40/70/100+ km/h). Treat AGENTS.md, PHYSICS_CONVENTIONS.md, and M5_VALIDATION.md as hard constraints.

Use the test to distinguish: (1) binary input over-command/full-lock saturation, (2) insufficient tire lateral capacity, (3) steering geometry/rate issue, or (4) another chassis/load-transfer defect. Prefer adding a reproducible regression/diagnostic and a minimal fix only when causality is demonstrated. Do not tune the track to compensate. Preserve analog wheel/mouse full mechanical rack authority. Run the relevant steering/tire/cornering tests, strict M5 validation, and build for any behavior change.
